card.name: Space after 'every' before hours
card.fires_on: The space (or the word 'every') right before a number of hours in dosing-interval text, such as 'Every 12 hours' or 'every 8 hours'. It appears in antibiotic dosing tables and schedules.

modes.label: Space after Every
modes.description: The blank token after 'Every' just before the hour number in a dosing interval.
modes.example: INFECTION DOSING REGIMEN Every<< >>12 hours Every 8 hours Am

modes.label: The word every itself
modes.description: The word 'Every' or 'every' when it directly follows a dose amount and leads into the hours.
modes.example: 15-25 mg/kg<< Every>> 6 hours Less than or equal to

card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing schedule where the number of hours between doses comes next.
